svg.title: AWS Public Change Alerting processing flow
svg.desc: Approved public AWS feeds, an immutable configuration and inventory release, and an exact application package enter deterministic candidate generation. Official AWS service icons identify Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, SQS, Secrets Manager, Systems Manager, CloudWatch, and SNS components. Candidates and delivery state are durable in DynamoDB. A dispatcher sends destination-grouped work through SQS FIFO to a Slack worker. Known and unknown outcomes return to DynamoDB, while bounded recovery and operational monitoring preserve evidence.

g.text: OBSERVABILITY: CloudWatch metrics + alarms · SNS operational notifications

svg.text: Logical architecture. Deployment status and evidence are maintained on the page below.
